_comment: Per-kind portrait overrides for game/scripts/render-portraits.mjs. Keys are entity kinds (or art kinds); each override is optional: distance (multiplier on the auto-fit camera distance, default 1), angle (camera azimuth in degrees, 0 = +z front / 90 = +x side, default 45), yOffset (world units added to the camera target height, default 0). Fill in by inspecting game/public/img/entity-atlas.png — auto-fit is the default, overrides only where it looks bad.
